summary_text: On 2026-04-18, a weekend, two separate orders were placed during the morning and afternoon dayparts. The morning order focused on breakfast components, combining dairy items (Curd Yogurt, Milk, Paneer Tofu) with Rusks. The afternoon order reflected a broader household replenishment need, including Breads, Dairy (Paneer Tofu), and Cleaning Supplies (Dish Cleaning Gel, Scrub Pad). No abandoned carts were recorded in either daypart. Because this analysis is based on a single observed date, durable preferences or stable patterns cannot be inferred.
